title: Mutual Divorce & Fair Settlement for Working Mother
summary: Secured a fair divorce settlement including child custody, maintenance, and property rights for a working mother.
clientChallenge: A working mother approached the office after years of marital disputes. She faced threats of losing custody of her two children and had no access to marital assets.
legalStrategy: Filed for divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act with a parallel petition for custody under the Guardianship and Wards Act. Applied for interim maintenance to stabilize the client's financial position during proceedings.
investigation: Collected financial records, property documents, school records of children, and documented evidence of the client's primary caregiving role.
documentation: Drafted detailed affidavits, financial disclosure statements, custody plan documents, and a comprehensive settlement proposal.
proceedings: The case was heard at Jalna Family Court over eight months. Successfully obtained interim custody orders and maintenance within the first two months.
resolution: Court awarded joint custody with primary residence to the mother, monthly maintenance of Rs.15,000 for children, one-time alimony, and fair share of marital home proceeds.
outcome_detail: Client was able to rebuild her life independently. Children's education continued without disruption.
lessonsLearned: Early evidence gathering and interim relief applications are critical in custody matters.
clientFeedback: Advocate Pavan understood my situation completely. He guided me through every step and made sure my children and I were protected. I am forever grateful.

title: Agricultural Land Dispute — Ancestral Property Rights Restored
summary: Recovered illegal possession of 4 acres of ancestral agricultural land through civil suit and revenue record correction.
clientChallenge: Three siblings approached our office after a distant relative had fraudulently transferred ancestral agricultural land through forged documents.
legalStrategy: Filed a civil suit for declaration and permanent injunction simultaneously with a complaint before the Revenue Authority for correction of records.
investigation: Obtained original land settlement records, commissioned a forensic document examination of the allegedly forged sale deed, and traced the paper trail of unauthorized transfers.
documentation: Compiled ancestral ownership evidence through old survey records, tax receipts, and family settlement documents dating back to 1978.
proceedings: Revenue enquiry was concluded in 6 months with findings in our favor. The civil suit was contested at every stage.
resolution: Jalna Civil Court decreed the suit in favor of the clients. Revenue records corrected. Fraudulent sale deed declared void.
outcome_detail: All 4 acres restored to rightful owners. Annual crop revenue resumed.
lessonsLearned: Simultaneous revenue and civil proceedings accelerate justice in land cases.
clientFeedback: We had lost hope after years of struggle. Advocate Pavan's knowledge of revenue laws and his persistence brought us justice.

title: Anticipatory Bail Secured in Serious Criminal Matter
summary: Obtained anticipatory bail for a young professional falsely implicated in a criminal conspiracy case.
clientChallenge: A young professional from Aurangabad was falsely named as an accused in a criminal conspiracy case. The FIR contained serious sections and arrest was imminent.
legalStrategy: Filed an anticipatory bail application before the Sessions Court immediately. Presented the client's clean background and strong ties to the community as grounds against flight risk.
investigation: Gathered CCTV footage, digital transaction records, and GPS location data that contradicted the prosecution's version.
documentation: Prepared a comprehensive anticipatory bail application with supporting affidavits, employer certificates, character references, and documentary alibi evidence.
proceedings: Sessions Court granted conditional anticipatory bail. The state challenged but the High Court upheld the Sessions Court decision.
resolution: Anticipatory bail granted. Client continued employment without arrest.
outcome_detail: Client was never arrested. Employment and reputation preserved.
lessonsLearned: Speed and quality of the initial bail application are decisive. Alibi evidence must be gathered immediately after FIR registration.
clientFeedback: I was terrified and didn't know what to do. Advocate Pavan acted swiftly and saved my career and my family's honor.
court: Jalna Sessions Court & Aurangabad High Court

title: Business Partnership Dissolution & Asset Recovery
summary: Successfully dissolved a disputed business partnership and recovered Rs.18 lakhs in misappropriated funds.
clientChallenge: A small business owner's partner began siphoning funds and refusing to render accounts. The partnership deed had ambiguous clauses being exploited.
legalStrategy: Filed a suit for dissolution of partnership, rendition of accounts, and recovery of misappropriated funds. Applied for interim injunction to freeze business assets.
investigation: Analyzed bank statements, GST returns, tally data and invoices over 3 years to reconstruct the financial picture.
documentation: Drafted detailed plaint with account reconstruction, forensic accounting summary, and evidence of unauthorized withdrawals.
proceedings: Court granted injunction within 15 days. Appointed a court receiver to manage accounts. Opposing party agreed to settlement under pressure.
resolution: Partnership dissolved, Rs.18 lakhs recovered in installments over 6 months, business assets divided.
outcome_detail: Client received full recovery. Resumed business independently.
lessonsLearned: Simultaneous civil and criminal proceedings create maximum pressure for settlement.
clientFeedback: My business partner cheated me for years. Advocate Pavan uncovered the truth and got me every rupee back.

title: Domestic Violence Protection Orders & Home Restoration

investigation: Documented photographic evidence of eviction, collected messages and call records showing harassment.
documentation: Filed detailed domestic incident report, affidavit of circumstances, evidence compilation.
proceedings: Magistrate Court granted protection order and residence order within 72 hours on emergency basis.

outcome_detail: Family stability restored. Children's education continued without disruption.

clientFeedback: I had nowhere to go with my children. Advocate Pavan brought us home within days. He is a protector.

title: High Court FIR Quashing — False Domestic Case

resolution: Bombay High Court quashed the FIR against all family members.
